entries.name: 余烬回响
entries.description: 每累计恢复30点魔力，触发一次烈焰爆发。
entries.motif: an orange flame curling around one blue mana drop

entries.name: 耗蓝连焰
entries.description: 每累计消耗20点魔力，触发烈焰爆发。
entries.motif: a blue drop cracking open into an orange flame

entries.name: 余烬收割

entries.motif: a crescent sickle cutting through one orange ember

entries.name: 焚尸余火
entries.description: 燃烧敌人死亡后留下地面，让击杀延伸成区域伤害。
entries.motif: one broad orange flame rising from a flat charred tile

entries.name: 灼烧升温
entries.description: 持续燃烧逐步提高目标受到的火焰伤害，奖励长时间燃烧。
entries.motif: a simple hourglass with an orange flame in its lower half

entries.name: 霜雷交响
entries.description: 命中施加冰缓与冻结；消耗冻结强化伤害，并触发附带感电的雷霆新星。
entries.motif: a split icy blue crystal crossed by one golden lightning bolt

entries.name: 冻体迸刺
entries.description: 命中冻结目标时额外发射冰刺，把控制转成额外投射。
entries.motif: three thick icy blue spikes erupting outward

entries.name: 霜痕遗留
entries.description: 冻结结束后留下冰缓区域，延长控制影响。
entries.motif: a broken blue snow crystal above a frosted oval patch

entries.name: 积电落雷
entries.description: 累计施加感电层数后落雷，把高频异常转成额外打击。
entries.motif: three stacked gold bars struck by a broad lightning bolt

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI icon atlas. Draw exactly a 3 by 3 regular grid on one square canvas with 9 separate dark-fantasy legendary talent icons. Transparent background with real alpha. No visible grid lines, no dividers, no tiles, no frames, no lettering, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. Every cell occupies exactly one third of canvas width and height; centers at 1/6, 3/6 and 5/6 of canvas. Each icon stays fully inside its own cell and fills about 64% of cell width or height, leaving generous transparent gutters. Never move an icon into another cell and never merge cells. Preserve the full square canvas even when some cells are empty.
Style: very simple hand-painted game emblems, bold clear silhouettes, only two or three large forms per icon, broad flat color facets, subtle bevel on one edge. Readable at 32 pixels. Reduce detail strongly: no tiny decorations, no complex scene, no characters, no lighting effects, no particles, no outer glow, no backdrop or cast shadows. Use warm gold accents with orange for fire, ice blue for frost, gold for lightning, jade for poison, crimson for life, teal for summons, blue silver for shields and violet for void. Consistent visual weight and edge treatment across the nine icons. Each motif below is a separate icon; do not draw these descriptions as text.
Row 1, column 1: an orange flame curling around one blue mana drop.
Row 1, column 2: a blue drop cracking open into an orange flame.
Row 1, column 3: a crescent sickle cutting through one orange ember.
Row 2, column 1: one broad orange flame rising from a flat charred tile.
Row 2, column 2: a simple hourglass with an orange flame in its lower half.
Row 2, column 3: a split icy blue crystal crossed by one golden lightning bolt.
Row 3, column 1: three thick icy blue spikes erupting outward.
Row 3, column 2: a broken blue snow crystal above a frosted oval patch.
Row 3, column 3: three stacked gold bars struck by a broad lightning bolt.

entries.name: 电殛传染

entries.motif: a branching gold lightning bolt with two outer prongs

entries.name: 瘟疫回潮
entries.description: 中毒达到5层时引爆；消耗异常后触发附带中毒的毒瓶。

entries.name: 毒性暴击
entries.description: 暴击有机会引爆毒层，让持续伤害转成爆发。

entries.name: 永恒之毒

entries.motif: two identical green drops joined by a short curved arrow

entries.name: 自毒连投

entries.name: 以血代蓝

entries.name: 献血蓄势
entries.description: 累计消耗气血强化下一次技能，把支付行为转成伤害。
entries.motif: a crimson drop feeding the point of a broad gold blade
